4. Business Gain & Revenue Impact for Lumen
Compresses the quote-to-provision cycle from days to minutes, allowing Lumen to start hourly/monthly NaaS billing immediately.
Automates pre-sales engineering and form-filling, allowing Lumen to profitably capture and onboard new customers without heavy sales intervention.
Removes the technical barrier to using Lumen Connect APIs, encouraging customers to spin up high-margin, on-demand bandwidth bursts more frequently.
Eliminates human data-entry mistakes in JSON payloads, reducing failed service orders and lowering Network Operations Center (NOC) support costs.
Higher Conversion Rates for New Leads
Instant, transparent location-based pricing and automated form-filling eliminate friction during the discovery phase, converting more prospects into paying accounts.
